name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme as the default for Excava’s interface. It cuts eye strain in low light and sharpens focus on data by reducing glare—critical for long analysis sessions. Trade-off: some users in bright environments may prefer light mode, but we’ll add a system toggle to switch instantly.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail when glare hits the screen—labs aren’t dim caves. A system toggle still fails when glare hits the screen—sensors can’t detect glare in real time. Instead, default to a light theme with a *manual* high-contrast mode triggered by user action, not automation. Settle it with a glare test: if the interface degrades in bright light, the toggle loses.
